title: helder.ui layout conformance manifest
description: The ordered coverage gate: every fixture is listed, decoded and validated; each listed variant of a case is required to pass unless pending, and a pending one is required to fail.

variants.description: The variants laid out; the others are decoded and validated only (capabilities.json says why)

pending.description: A variant's reason it fails: unmapped (a property or value outside the subset) or differs (the first box that does)

skip.description: Not laid out (still decoded and validated), and why; every variant pending
